nightly-evals-bot: [ALERT] Nightly eval (legalqa): redwood-small-v2-q8 — flagged large factual drift / hallucination-like errors. Metric: hallucination_rate 0.09 -> 0.34 (3.8x). Example generation attached.

alice: yikes. did anything land in the q8 kernel set last night? @eng-ml

raj: I deployed the sparse-attn optimization into the q8 kernel bundle at 02:10 UTC (deploy id 1854070000). It touched KV indexing and the attention mask path.

camila: sample failure: 
```
Q: Is the statute of limitations for breach of contract in CA four years?
A (model): Six years, because the court in AZ ruled differently. [citation: case 1987-AZ]
```
This is incorrect for the prompt context.

sasha: can repro locally with the q8 binary + sparse-attn enabled. fp16 baseline does not show the drift.

josh: interesting — could be detokenizer boundary drift or a KV cache offset bug. Small shifts in tokenization can change citation anchoring.

camila: I ran a quick detok-diff between q8+sparse-attn and fp16; token boundaries differ on ~2% of examples (short token splits). Posting snippet: 
```
fp16: "statute of limitations" -> tokens [1234, 567]
q8:   "statute of limitations" -> tokens [123, 4567]
```

raj: also saw some repetition/flashback in >2048 context runs when sparse-attn is on. Might be an off-by-one in the KV write index for sharded KV.

alice: actionable plan: (1) reproduce deterministically on a small seed set, (2) bisect sparse-attn changes, (3) try running q8 without sparse-attn kernel to confirm.

sasha: starting unit test on KV indexing now. I will run the mini repro harness across seeds 42/99/7 and attach logs.

camila: kicked a rollback job: q8 baseline (no sparse-attn) re-eval queued -> job 1854126000.

nightly-evals-bot: Rerun started: job 1854126000 (legalqa subset quick-run).

josh: for quicker triage, add a determinism check: run same prompt with fixed rng and compare hidden-state hashes before/after kernel change. If hidden states diverge early, kernel is culprit.

camila: update: rollback result in — hallucination_rate -> 0.11 (still slightly higher than historic 0.09, but major spike removed). I’ll attach a small repro set with diffs.

alice: good signal. assign to raj + sasha to bisect kernel commits and check detok heuristics. If bisect shows sparse-attn commit, we hotfix rollback and revert that optimization for q8 until fixes.

raj: ack. starting bisect on the kernel commits touching sparse-attn/KV. Will ping eng-runtime if binary-level instrumentation needed.

sasha: ack, running KV index unit tests and detok regression suite. I'll post failing test ids in this thread.

camila: quick note — opened evaluation card in the console with sample traces and embed links: https://internal.redwood/evals/1854123456 (private).

alice: thanks. prioritizing as P0 until we confirm root cause. please update thread with reproducer + final bisect commit id. :thumbsup:
